title: Tenure Weighting of Conduct-Complaint Credits under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the credits a shopper earns in a conduct-complaint dispute weigh more with tenure.

**Rule.** The counter-wait credit and the praise credit are added, and that sum is then adjusted by the shopper's tenure, counted in calendar days from the account's first activation date to the dispute: with 1095 days or more the sum is doubled; with 365 days up to 1094 days (one fewer than 1095) it is increased by half of itself, the half rounded up to a whole point; with less it is used as it stands.

The first activation date is the activation date recorded on the contractor account; the count runs to the day of the dispute.

## Adjustment by tenure

| Tenure on the day of the dispute | Counter-wait and praise sum |
|---|---|
| 1095 days or more | Doubled |
| 365 to 1094 days | Increased by half of itself, the half rounded up |
| 0 to 364 days | Used as it stands |

## Worked sums (hypothetical)

| Sum before adjustment | 1095 days or more | 365 to 1094 days | Under 365 days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 points | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 1 point | 2 | 2 (half of 1 rounded up to 1) | 1 |
| 3 points | 6 | 5 (half of 3 rounded up to 2) | 3 |
| 4 points | 8 | 6 | 4 |

Tenure of exactly 1095 days doubles the sum; 1094 days takes the half-increase; exactly 365 days takes the half-increase; 364 days leaves the sum as it stands.
